column1: # Black/Matrix AD - Chapter 4 archangels' final trial, part 1
# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: My true name is $$ウリエル$$, the $$大天使$$ who embodies repentance!!
Either way, this $$世界$$ has already fallen apart.
If this is a trial to make you the creator of a new $$世界$$...
then I will come at you without holding back!!
Heh... Just as I thought!
Me, who was so obsessed with strength and power...
Why is it that, even though I lost, I do not regret it at all!?
Now it is my turn!
My true name is $$サリエル$$, the $$大天使$$ of noble death!!
People must not...
run away from the adversity before them!!
This strength...
you helped me remember it...
Thanks to meeting you...
I was truly... happy...
Next, it is my turn!
My true name is $$ラグエル$$, the $$大天使$$ of vengeance!!
I believe you are the one who should inherit my dear friend $$セラフィム$$'s ideals...
That is why...
I will not hold back!
We were together only a short time, but...
I think of you as...
my second dear friend!!
Good grief, is it finally my turn!
My true name, as you already know, is...
$$ラファエル$$, the $$大天使$$ of ruin and life!
Do not underestimate me just because I am old!!
After all, I have lived for fifteen billion years!
Do you remember...
when we first met...?
The fruit you shared from your farm...
that $$リンゴ$$ was exceedingly delicious!!
I have finally fulfilled my duty as well... I will be with you soon...
